summary: Black Rock Petroleum filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026 under Items 5.02 and 8.01 disclosing the immediate resignation of Zoltan Nagy as sole director, CEO, president and principal financial/accounting officer, and the contemporaneous appointment of Sam Epstein to the board and the same sole-officer roles effective the same day. The filing states Nagy's resignation was not related to any operations, policies or practices dispute, and the company also announced a relocation of its corporate address and phone number to be detailed later. No material deal terms, advisors, or board recommendation were disclosed. Watch for follow-on disclosure on the new officer's compensation, governance reconstitution and the delayed address update.
